# Лира — SA-02 / 1E.1: подтверждённые Better Auth 1.7.7 transition seams (2026-11-10)

**Author discovery complete; implementation PR #319 unchanged** at exact head `e9a6b19e1910f43a5e5f8484543562763b316e37`. This 1E.1 checkpoint is source analysis and integration contract, **not** completed event writer/hooks.

Accepted SA02 plan Lev [#6768069279](https://github.com/iliya1947/vico-forum/pull/251#issuecomment-6768069279) §6 demands five exact facts, occurrence dedup, no 200-as-proof, no secrets and no false lifecycle counts.

**Verified against pinned upstream tag [better-auth/v1.7.7](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/tree/v1.7.7)**:
1. [`db/with-hooks.ts`](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/blob/v1.7.7/packages/better-auth/src/db/with-hooks.ts) queues user/account/session create/update/delete `after` callbacks with `queueAfterTransactionHook`; [`core/context/transaction.ts`](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/blob/v1.7.7/packages/core/src/context/transaction.ts) executes queued hooks after a successful adapter commit and drops them on transaction failure. Outside a transaction callbacks run after individual writes, so an unrelated later HTTP failure does not prove rollback. Hooks are evidence of a specific persisted change, not a successful whole auth workflow.
2. `user.create.after` carries real user ID for `account.created`; `account.create.after` carries account ID, user ID and actual provider for `auth.methodLinked`. Restrict provider to credential/google, and distinguish initial registration from an actual explicit linking route; provider token refresh runs `updateAccount`, **not** new method link. `session.create.after` carries session ID and user ID for `auth.sessionCreated`.
3. [`api/routes/session.ts`](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/blob/v1.7.7/packages/better-auth/src/api/routes/session.ts): `getSession` may delete expired sessions; must not become `auth.sessionDeleted`. Native `revoke-session` returns status true even when target not found; `revoke-sessions` and `revoke-other-sessions` delete multiple/certain sessions. [`api/routes/sign-out.ts`](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/blob/v1.7.7/packages/better-auth/src/api/routes/sign-out.ts) catches deletion failure yet may return success. Only explicitly correlated revoke/sign-out paths and a verified prior row + confirmed actual absence/DB effect can produce `auth.sessionDeleted`. `with-hooks.ts` `delete.after` enumerates pre-images and may run even under concurrent no-op/race: **do not claim exact deleting actor from hook presence alone**. Native PG race proof required.
4. [`db/internal-adapter.ts`](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/blob/v1.7.7/packages/better-auth/src/db/internal-adapter.ts) `updatePassword(userId,hash)` uses **`updateManyWithHooks`** against credential account and returns row count-like update result; `account.update.after` does not identify a single changed account. `auth.passwordChanged` requires canonical `/change-password`, server-owned operation ID, authoritative credential account ID and post-persist proof. Other `updateAccount` token refresh is not password change. Never persist/transmit password/hash.
5. Existing `owner_events` has append-only `unique(source,occurrence_key)`; current [`db/owner-system-history.ts`](https://github.com/iliya1947/vico-forum/blob/main/db/owner-system-history.ts) restricts `source='system'`, System kinds/monitors/payload. Next implementation should use **narrow code-backed SA02 fact writer**, with `source='auth'` and five known kinds, rather than loosen System writer to arbitrary event. Creation/deletion dedup by kind+immutable entity ID; password by server operation ID+credential account ID. Identity: persisted target user ID separate from verified actor; never use email/expectedUserId/cookie/token/client labels.
6. Fact production must never veto or change Better Auth transaction/HTTP responses; independently queue/flush best-effort, preserve immutable native event count (no attempt coalescing) and surface gap when storage unavailable. Existing 1D request-local attempt limit does not become a cap on persisted transition facts.

**Remaining verification/implementation in bounded 1E.2–1E.3**: native PG writer with actual `owner_events` integrity/dedup and exhaustive safe payload checks; real Better Auth hook wiring plus source-specific receipt/correlation, race/no-op/partial-commit/postcommit failures, signout, OAuth registration and explicit linking/password/session tests. Future reader/History/UI remains separate.

**1E.1 stop:** no runtime changes, migrations, CI triggers, worker routing, PR status or release actions made. Developer `...` authorizes 1E.2 writer only; later 1E.3 wiring/tests separately.

## SET-05 — подзадача 1/4: контракты и действующий auth route (2026-11-08)

- Актуальный main подтверждён GitHub branch API: `76fc5b16be4f2425a0ad1fdcb7b38974db355c56`. SET-04 #307/#308 merged; SET-05 implementation назначен Лире, implementation PR ещё нет. План: #251 comment #6711736883.
- Прочитаны `main/AGENTS.md`, общий implementation plan, актуальные workflow и relevant communication, `PROJECT.md`, `PROJECT_STATE.md`, `docs/SETTINGS.md`; просмотрены действующие `AuthRuntime`, `auth.server.ts`, request/session-context, Worker pre-routing, Settings shell/paths/user route, Profile Google component и routing.
- Current `AuthRuntime` предоставляет только `getSession` и `handle`. `createHyperdriveAuthRuntime` уже имеет request-local `useAuth` с отдельным PostgreSQL client и disposal. `workers/app.ts` сначала выполняет `initializeAuthContext`, затем React Router request и `withAuthSessionCookies` (pre-routing cookies перед endpoint cookies, с сохранением порядка).
- Пин проекта: Better Auth **1.7.7**. Исходный официальный tag `better-auth/better-auth@v1.7.7` проверен через GitHub: `listUserAccounts` / GET `/list-accounts` использует sessionMiddleware; `listSessions` / GET `/list-sessions` использует `freshSessionMiddleware` и отклоняет stale `SESSION_NOT_FRESH`; `revokeSession` / POST `/revoke-session` и `revokeOtherSessions` / POST `/revoke-other-sessions` используют authoritative `sensitiveSessionMiddleware`. Revoke-one принимает **token**, поэтому внешнее действие должно принимать только session ID и находить собственный token внутри сервера.
- `changePassword` / POST `/change-password` имеет обязательные current/new password, `sensitiveSessionMiddleware` и опциональный `revokeOtherSessions`. В v1.7.7 при флаге true Better Auth удаляет все пользовательские sessions и создаёт новую с новым cookie; SET-05 держит смену пароля и explicit revoke-others раздельно. `setPassword` для OAuth-only остаётся вне scope.
- `GoogleAccountLink` и existing `linkGoogleAccount` сейчас находятся в собственном Profile; SET-05 переиспользует их с прежним session-bound `x-vico-link-user`, не создаёт второй link flow. `settings/account` ещё не зарегистрирован; SettingsShell содержит pending account placeholder.
- Точки следующей реализации: `app/auth/request-context.ts`, `app/auth/auth.server.ts`, `app/routes.ts`, `app/settings/paths.ts`, `app/settings/shell.tsx`, новая route `app/routes/settings-account.tsx`, затем Profile relocation и translations/tests. Это карта затрагиваемых границ, не предписание конкретного решения.

## Permanent execution guard — oversized handoffs

Before starting any new implementation assignment from #251:

- verify that the assignment is one bounded subtask, not a full multi-step technical plan;
- if the assignment contains multiple independently completable results, do not silently execute them all as one task;
- complete only the explicitly assigned bounded subtask and STOP;
- require a new developer continuation/assignment before proceeding to the next independent subtask.

This guard complements Mira's handoff-granularity gate and is intended to catch an oversized assignment even if the coordinator misses it.
